nodes.label: ADR 0148: GLUE Home's queue hands each song to the native engine
nodes.rationale: Batch 3 of ADR 0147 moves analysis work to Rust while keeping the queue in the service page. One command analyse_song(path, p, c, id, mtime) in Rust checks paths, reads files whole with pacing, tells the service page when reading is done for the Speed panel, analyses on its own thread with a 2-minute or per-MB deadline, and writes results. Same failures as before handled in the same words. cache.analyse() keeps its shape for unchanged queue and background fill. Tests via tauri-mock.ts with website pipeline in .e2e-home/. verify_song skips natively-analysed songs.

nodes.label: analyse_song: native Rust analysis command
nodes.rationale: In home/src-tauri/src/analysis.rs. Takes (path, p, c, id, mtime). Checks path is in readable folder, reads file whole with pacing for playback, tells service page when reading done (analysis-step event for Speed panel), analyses on own thread with deadline, writes t/w/d/a/p/s caches. Same failures as before, retried or failed.
